caption: The drawing depicts a cast iron lamp mounted on a brick wall. The lamp is hexagonal in shape with a domed top and a finial at its peak. The upper section of the lamp features circular designs on each face, while the middle section is elongated with three panel-like surfaces showing diagonal hatching, possibly to suggest glass panes. The base of the lamp widens and then tapers into a pointed end, featuring small decorative motifs. The lamp is labeled with the text "CAST IRON LAMP" at the bottom. The brick wall on which it is mounted is represented by a repetitive pattern of rectangles indicating bricks, and to the right of the lamp, there is a partial archway sketched in with two arrows and the measurements "20''" and "5'4''" indicating the width and the height of the lamp, respectively. The drawing is executed in black ink on a beige background, and all shading and texture are depicted using line work and cross-hatching.
title: Cast Iron Lamp
cluster: #16 — Lighting Devices: Lamps, Lanterns, and Candleholders
